audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagreed with the packet and with their own prose. win[0] said Mel while whys[0] says 'so do you, so just farm'; win[4] said Mel while whys[4] says All Out dashes through her and she has no dash to answer; win[6] said K'Sante while whys[6] said Mel reclaims it.
audit.why: 52.65% over 735 games is a K'Sante-favoured lane, and the packet chart (Skill, Skill, K'Sante, K'Sante, K'Sante, K'Sante, Skill) matches the prose everywhere except whys[6], which itself rests on a fabricated ult-reflect.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side + win[0] -> Skill (3/10 -> 5/10), phases[4].side + win[4] -> K'Sante (3/10 -> 6/10), phases[6].side + win[6] -> Skill (6/10 -> 5/10), as matched pairs; whys[6] rewritten to a parity claim that is actually true.
sources: this page's own whys[0] and whys[4]

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that no Mel ability is ever named, and the one cooldown the page tells you to track — Solar Snare — is given no number.
audit.why: Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s from 1000 range, but the cooldown that actually decides commits is Rebuttal at 38/35/33/29/26s. A 26-38 second window is enormous and the page never told the reader it exists.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal's 38/35/33/29/26s written into the interactions row, mid, whys[6] and spikes[1]; Solar Snare's 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and 1000 range into dosFull[0].d; Radiant Volley's 950 range used to replace 'her short Q range'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four errors. (1) THE REFLECT IS ON THE WRONG ABILITY. Five strings tell you to 'bait her R reflect' — Golden Eclipse (R) does not reflect anything; it strikes every Overwhelm-marked enemy globally. The reflect is REBUTTAL (W), on a 38/35/33/29/26s cooldown. A reader holding their all-in for her ultimate holds it forever and eats the real reflect every time. (2) Rebuttal reflects PROJECTILES, and Ntofo Strikes is flagged projectile — your own Q comes back at you, which is the decisive interaction and appears nowhere. (3) 'charge unstoppable through it' in three paths — Path Maker is reduced damage taken, not unstoppable. (4) 'Q3 knock-up' in five paths — Ntofo Strikes has no knockup or third cast; at 2 stacks it fires a shockwave that pulls.
audit.why: Kit text is the authority, and the mirror already corrected the same two-stack-pull error from Mel's side.
audit.corrected: Reflect moved to Rebuttal everywhere with its cooldown, the Ntofo-comes-back-at-you interaction stated, W re-described as a damage-reduced charge, and the pull named correctly. Golden Eclipse re-described as the global Overwhelm detonation it is.
sources: kit: Mel W 'reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker'
kit: K'Sante Q projectile flag, W text

audit.whatIsWrong: 'your Passive move speed' in two strings — K'Sante's passive marks targets to take more damage on his next attack and grants no move speed.
audit.why: Riot's passive text gives no movement effect; the speed is on Footwork and All Out.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the Ntofo Strikes slow stacking with Iceborn's, which does the same job and is real.

edits.before: She has only her Q poke and no escape at Level 1, but so do you — last-hit at the tip of your Q and don't burn W charging at a target who can just step back. Eat a little poke; her Q chip cannot out-damage your tank base stats this early. The moment you hit Level 3 and have W plus Q online, the lane flips: bait her Q, then W-charge unstoppable through it and Q3 to pin her.
edits.after: She has only her Q poke and no escape at Level 1, but so do you — last-hit at the tip of your Q and don't burn W charging at a target who can just step back. Eat a little poke; her Q chip cannot out-damage your tank base stats this early. The moment you hit Level 3 and have W plus Q online, the lane flips: bait her Q, then W-charge through it on reduced damage and land the Ntofo pull.

edits.before: This is your takeover. Once you can W-charge through her poke and Q3 knock-up, she has no dash to escape your range — pin her against the wave or terrain and her squishy frame folds. At 6, All Out lets you dash through her and duel, but respect her R: if she reflects your burst window your shred bounces back, so force the all-in when her R is down or after she's wasted it. With Iceborn your slow and Passive move speed glue you to her and her short Q can't kite.
edits.after: This is your takeover. Once you can W-charge through her poke and land the two-stack Ntofo pull, she has no dash to escape your range — pin her against the wave or terrain and her squishy frame folds. At 6, All Out lets you dash through her and duel, but respect Rebuttal: it reflects projectiles, so your own Ntofo Strikes bounces back at you. Force it out — 26s even at rank 5 — then commit. With Iceborn your slow glues you to her and 950 poke cannot kite.

edits.before: You own every clean 1v1 through your item spikes, but full-AP Mel becomes the danger late — she pokes from outside your Q and W range and her R can blank your engage in a teamfight by reflecting it back. Your armor stacking does nothing against her magic poke and execute, so don't bet on the very late game. Close the side lane and snowball your earlier-to-mid leads before her ranged scaling and R turn fights against you.
edits.after: You own every clean 1v1 through your item spikes, and Mel stays beatable late provided you respect two things: she pokes from 950 range, outside your Q, and Rebuttal reflects projectiles straight back at you. Your armour does nothing against her magic, so build MR and force Rebuttal out before every engage. Close the side lane and snowball your earlier leads before Golden Eclipse can detonate a chipped team from anywhere.

notes: The reflect-on-the-wrong-ability error is the worst thing I found in this slice: five strings told the reader to bait Mel's ULTIMATE for a reflect that lives on her W. Following that advice means never committing (her R is not the gate) while walking every Ntofo Strikes into an actual reflect. Rebuttal also creates terrain per its flags, which may block the Path Maker and All Out dashes, but Riot's text does not say so — not asserted, flagged here. The mirror mel__ksante reported that apply-proposals.js refuses full-layer edits with a `before` under 12 characters, which would block phases[N].side; my instructions state those fields are ENUM-exempt, so I have proposed the side and rating pairs.
